content_data.email_purpose: To outline strategic research priorities for enhancing digital accessibility in healthcare, leveraging current technological advancements.
key_points: Proposed framework for integrating inclusive design principles into healthcare digital platforms.
Analysis of existing European accessibility standards and identification of gaps.
Recommendations for pilot projects focusing on underserved populations in healthcare.
